Our Story

Pap is not ordinary food.

It fed every generation before us. It was the first thing most Nigerian babies tasted. It is what mothers reach for when the body needs to heal. Ogi has earned its place at every table — we just refused to let it be reduced to a dusty shelf product.

At Delightsome Food Ventures, every batch is prepared fresh after you order. We source whole grains, mill them ourselves, and deliver to your door. No preservatives. No filler starch. No bleaching. Just the grain, just the goodness.

We offer eleven varieties — from single-grain classics to protein-enriched power blends and naturally date-sweetened options — because every family has a different need, and every need deserves a real answer.

Why Choose Delightsome

Pap that works as hard as your family does.

Most pap sold today is refined, bleached, or sitting on a shelf for weeks. Here is what we do differently — and why it matters.

🌿

Digestive Fibre

Whole grains retain the natural bran and germ — that is where the fibre lives. One bowl a day supports gut health for toddlers, nursing mothers, and adults managing digestion. Refined alternatives strip all of this out.

💪

Complete Protein

Our Nutty Delight blend includes soyabean — one of the few plant foods delivering all nine essential amino acids. Paired with groundnut for healthy fat, it is a complete meal, not just a porridge.

⚡

Natural Energy

No refined sugar. No additives. The carbohydrate energy comes from the grain itself, releasing steadily rather than spiking and crashing. Better for children's focus. Better for adults managing blood sugar.

Flavour Add-Ons

Three spices. Built in, not sprinkled.

Added dry before milling — so the flavour is ground into the pap, not dusted on after. Mention your spice preference when ordering.

Ginger

Warming and slightly sharp. Aids digestion and reduces nausea. A traditional pairing with pap for nursing mothers. Pairs with all varieties.

Cloves

Aromatic and deeply sweet. Rich in antioxidants. Works best with heavier blends — Nutty Delight and Heritage Mix.

Cayenne Pepper

Heat and anti-inflammatory properties together. For adults who want a savoury, warming bowl. Request it intentionally.
